tilts.set: SET on 2026-11-06 by the Portfolio Fitness for Fighting judg

industry.why: Overweight, carried; the condition for Double Overweight (defensives leading for a second month with the industry's relative strength at B or better) is half met: defensives lead on all five windows, the three-month line at +6.6 points, but Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: C now, D prior, short of B. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). Three live holdings (Carlsberg 4.67%, Fevertree 2.48%, Hilton Food 4.78%, 11.93 points) read A on Thematic Fit/Momentum through this row. Counter-case: a defensive destination two months into a rotation is crowded, and no staples house view was read this week. To A if relative strength reaches B with defensives still leading at three months.

sector.why: Overweight, carried, on the special topic 'The UK Budget of 28-Oct-26': non-discretionary demand and proven cases, with the pay floor rising 3.9% in April 2027 against 4.1% in April 2026 and food tariffs cut. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): staples are the destination of the rotation to defensives, and Nestlé's 4.3% pet care growth read across to ingredients (Jefferies, 23 October). Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: C now, D prior, the market has started to pay. One live holding, Hilton Food (3.30%, Fitness 77.8). Counter-case: input-cost inflation squeezes producers before it reaches retailers. Moves to A with the staples industry if defensives lead for a second month.

geography.why: Neutral, carried, with the evidence for Underweight named and judged thin. Goldman Sachs (16 Oct) names 'worrying debt dynamics' in Belgium alongside France, Belgium, Austria and Finland; that is one clause in one note with no spread reading, the same footing on which Ireland was held Neutral last week for Overweight, so the row does not move on it. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Relative strength is not graded by country. Moves to D if a second source names Belgium or a spread reading is read widening.

experiment.label: Experiment
experiment.method: own daily moves (Stoxx Europe 600 and country-of-listing average removed), rank correlation, last 63 and 126 sessions; candidates EUR 500m or more in the same sector, cohort or country of listing

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
